name: Andolor: Three Moons Atlas
description: The approved Aylor 0.3.0 style across all 114 Aardwolf terrains: fine continuous materials, compact overhead scenery, richer fantasy accents and local sculpted depth. Shared slate and timber keep room layouts readable. Version 1.0.0.
